dataSource: City of Milwaukee Building Permits (CKAN open data portal), queried live
notes: Pulled live from the city's CKAN open data portal on every search, not a static extract — coverage reflects whatever the city has published as of your search, refreshed monthly.
Matched by house number plus the first word of the street name; results may occasionally include unrelated records that happen to share both.
If the primary search finds nothing, an exact full-address match is tried as a fallback before giving up.
summary: Milwaukee is covered by a live query against the city's public building permits dataset, matched by address as you search.
